jobs.occupation: Junior Cloud RAN Layer 1 SW Developer
jobs.description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity 
  
 Are you about to graduate, or have you recently completed your university studies in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Embedded Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field? 
 Join Ericsson's Cloud RAN Layer 1 organization and help build the technology that powers next-generation mobile networks. 
 Our teams develop performance-critical software at the heart of 5G and future radio systems. As a Junior Software Engineer, you will work alongside experienced developers and technical experts to learn how advanced wireless communication systems are designed, implemented, tested, and optimized. 
 This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and excited about solving challenging technical problems in a collaborative environment. 
  
 What you will do 
  
  Develop and maintain software in Ericsson's Cloud RAN Layer 1 platform.
 Use AI-assisted engineering workflows to support activities such as developing code, test creation, debugging, documentation, and code review.
 Work with modern C++ and performance-critical software components.
 Learn how 5G/6G radio systems and physical layer processing work.
 Participate in feature development, debugging, testing, code reviews, and continuous integration activities.
 Collaborate with software developers, architects, system engineers, and testers across global teams.
 Contribute to software quality, test coverage, maintainability, and continuous improvement.
 Explore and contribute to AI/ML-enabled features that may be implemented in the product, including prototyping, integration, testing, and evaluation together with experienced engineers.
 Grow your technical skills through mentorship, feedback, and hands-on experience. 
  
 
 The skills you bring 
  
  Programming experience in C/C++, Python, Julia.
 Foundational understanding of AI and machine learning concepts.
 Practical experience using Python for data processing, experimentation, or machine learning through university coursework, thesis work, or personal projects.
 Experience with Linux development environments, Git, unit testing, CI/CD, or cloud-native technologies.
 Basic understanding of 5G, mobile networks, physical layer processing, or 3GPP concepts.
 Ability to use AI-assisted development tools critically and responsibly.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Interest in software engineering, high-performance systems, and telecommunications.
 Good communication skills in English.
 Curiosity, collaboration, ownership, and a strong willingness to learn. 
  
 
 You do not need previous professional telecom or Layer 1 experience. We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility, and the motivation to grow.
  
 Please send your CV in English.

Join Our Team as a Process Engineer (GMP)
We are currently seeking experienced and motivated **Process Engineers (GMP)** to join our dynamic team. As a pivotal part of our operations, the Process Engineer will play a crucial role in ensuring the efficiency and effectiveness of our processes. If you have a passion for technology and a keen eye for detail, we encourage you to apply.
About the Role
As a Process Engineer, you will be involved in the manufacturing of ATMP products, to be used in clinical trials. The position is a full time permanent position with an initial probationary period of six months. Working hours in this role follow a staggered weekly schedule/shift work including weekend work.
This role at Anocca is suited to experienced and motivated professionals with a drive to lead and execute by action. Experience in aseptic work, including processing of ATMPs, as well as in electronic batch management systems would be a significant asset.
You should have high-quality relevant experience, excellent English communication skills, knowledge of aseptic manufacturing techniques, and be securely anchored in GMP regulations. You must be capable of working as part of a team but should also demonstrate initiative to drive projects forward.
What We're Looking For:
Manufacturing experience in the cell therapy or ATMP space
Previous experience in Good Manufacturing Practise (GMP)
Significant and relevant experience in cell processing equipment and validation
Good grasp of the underlying biology, preferably experience in T-cell immunology
Fluent written and spoken English

Why Join Us?
Our company is at the forefront of technological innovation, striving to make a difference in the industry. We offer a dynamic working environment where talent and ambition are recognized and rewarded. Join us, and be part of a team that values growth, collaboration, and the pursuit of excellence.
We Offer:
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
A collaborative and supportive work culture.
State-of-the-art facilities and resources.

How to Apply:
If this Process Engineer position resonates with you, we would love to hear from you. Submit your application, including your CV and a cover letter, through our careers portal. Join us in making a difference, apply now!
Recruitment may take place on an ongoing basis.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group ("friskola") with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is through both Swedish and English, with English the language of the corridors. IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at "Grundskolan" with 43 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993. IES Eskilstuna is one of the largest schools in Sweden with 1,185 students enrolled in grades F-9 and approx 125 staff members.
IES Eskilstuna söker nu en engagerad elevassistent, på heltid, som vill arbeta nära elever och pedagoger för att skapa en trygg, strukturerad och inkluderande lärmiljö.Som elevassistent arbetar du nära lärare och elevhälsa för att stödja eleven i lärande och social utveckling.- Du ger pedagogiskt stöd under lektioner och bidrar till struktur och tydlighet i skoldagen.Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av arbete med barn i grundskola. Vi ser gärna att du även tidigare har arbetat som elevassistent. Du är känslomässigt stabil, har självinsikt, är trygg i dig själv och ser relationer i sitt rätta perspektiv och skiljer på det personliga och professionella.Du drivs av en vilja att se möjligheterna till förbättringar för såväl eleven och dina kollegor som för den egna verksamheten. Du har en förmåga att snabbt kunna anpassa dig till nya eller förändrade krav och förutsättningar. Att arbeta tillsammans med andra med en godsammanhållning och ett öppet arbetsklimat är något som du uppskattar och värdesätter.Vi tror också att du:löser konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt
är lugn, tydlig och relationsskapande
kan se elevernas olika behov, ge beröm och vägledning
har kunskap om NPF
har ett lågaffektivt bemötande
Mycket god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift är ett krav för tjänsten, då vi är en tvåspråkig arbetsplats.Rekryteringen sker löpande så vi rekommenderar att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.
För att arbeta hos oss krävs att du ska ha fyllt 18 år och du behöver ett utdrag ur belastningsregister, ansök via länken.
https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/skola-eller-forskola/ 
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Om jobbet:
Vi söker nu pålitliga och serviceinriktade leveransförare till vårt team i norra Stockholm. Hos Valjochslapp arbetar vi med att leverera paket och varor snabbt, säkert och med ett trevligt bemötande direkt till våra kunder.
Tjänsten är på heltid med varierande arbetstider förlagda till både morgon- och kvällspass (cirka kl. 06:00–14:00 och 16:00–23:00 enligt schema). Du utgår från vår depå i norra Stockholm och kör ett av företagets fordon.
Dina arbetsuppgifter:
Lasta och säkra leveranser i fordonet inför din rutt.
Planera och köra effektiva leveransrutter under morgon- och kvällstid.
Leverera varor till privatpersoner och företag med fokus på god kundservice.
Hantera digital leveransrapportering via handdator eller mobilapp.
Hålla fordonet rent, snyggt och trafiksäkert.

Kvalifikationer och krav:
Körkort: Giltigt B-körkort för manuell växellåda som du har haft i minst 6 månader (svenskt eller EU/EES).
Språk: Goda kunskaper i svenska eller engelska i tal och skrift för att kunna kommunicera med kunder och kollegor.
Arbetstider: Du är flexibel och har möjlighet att arbeta både tidiga morgnar, sena kvällar samt helger enligt schema.
Personliga egenskaper: Du är punktlig, ansvarstagande, stresstålig och trivs med att arbeta självständigt i ett högt tempo.
Tidigare erfarenhet av budkörning eller serviceyrken är meriterande, men inget krav.

Anställningsvillkor:
Omfattning: Heltid (100 %), skiftarbete (morgon, kväll och helg).
Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning (3 månader) med god möjlighet till förlängning.
Tillträde: Omgående eller enligt överenskommelse.

Ansökan:
Skicka din ansökan med CV och ett kort personligt brev till jobb@valjochslapp.se märkt med "Leveransförare". Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan!

English Summary:
Valjochslapp is looking for reliable, service-minded full-time Delivery Drivers based in Northern Stockholm.
Hours: Full-time (100%), rotating shifts covering early mornings (approx. 06:00–14:00), evenings (approx. 16:00–23:00), and weekends according to schedule.
Requirements: Valid manual B-driver's license held for at least 6 months (Swedish or EU/EEA), good communication skills in Swedish or English, and flexibility to work morning, evening, and weekend shifts. Previous delivery experience is a merit, not a requirement.
Employment: Fixed-term contract (3 months) with strong potential for extension. Start date immediately or by agreement.
How to apply: Send your CV and a brief introduction to jobb@valjochslapp.se with the subject "Leveransförare". Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

Undervisningen på IES följer svensk läroplan och kursplaner.

jobs.occupation: Early Years Class Assistant, International School of Helsingborg
jobs.description:
About us
The International School of Helsingborg has provided a truly international education at the Primary and Secondary levels since 1995. Today, we have approximately 650 students between 3 and 19 years of age, across all programmes. We are an IB Continuum school, delivering the International Baccalaureate curriculum for all program levels. English is the primary language of learning at the school.
ISH prides itself on its diversity within and among all members of the learning community. Every member of our learning community brings something exciting and enriching to the school, which creates an inspiring environment. The aim of our school is to develop internationally minded people who, recognising their common humanity and shared guardianship of the planet, help to create a better and more peaceful world.
Read more about the International School of Helsingborg on our website: https://internationalschool.helsingborg.se/
Job description
As an early years assistant, your role will be to organize and monitor activities for the students, ages 3-5 in the early years program. You will work with a team of early years teachers and will be expected to interact with the students in a caring manner. You will be expected to lead a group of students with positive behavior management techniques. You will be expected to work together in a team with the early years colleagues in order to plan engaging activities for the students. The hours vary on a daily basis approximately between 07:30 and 17:30 each day.
The position includes supporting students and teachers in the regular classroom during the school day in addition to after-school activities. We are looking for someone who works well in a team. You are positive, open minded and flexible. When working with the students, you are consistent and kind. You take the time to get to know the students and build relationships with them. You take initiative within organizing activities and helping to make early years a place students enjoy.
Qualifications
A degree or certificate within early years and/or in primary education is preferred.
The successful candidate will have at least two years’ experience working with groups of kids in the ages 3-5, including working with children with various support needs.
The primary language of the school is English. Therefore, it is critical and required that any candidates are able to read, write and speak in English fluently.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.
https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/RoboticsAI?l=en, RAI, at the Deaprtment of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineeering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for a PhD student to contribute to our growing activities. The RAI team conducts basic and fundamental research into all aspects of robotics, with a specific focus on aerial, space and bio-inspired robotics.
 
 
Subject description
 
Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterised by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.
 
 
Project description
 
RAI’s fundamental vision is to bridge the gap between theory and reality, and the team has a strong background in field robotics. Specific application areas we focus on include long-term autonomous missions in large and uncertain environments, semantic mission planning using foundation models, agentic task decomposition and event-driven replanning, and autonomous, semantically aware inspection of complex infrastructure. The RAI team has strong European and national participation in several research, development and innovation projects.
 
 
Duties
 
As a PhD student, you will conduct research with substantial theoretical and experimental components, to be published in peer-reviewed, internationally recognized journals and at major conferences. The position includes supervising degree projects and providing support with applications for funding from research funding agencies or councils, EU framework programmes or industry. The position may also include teaching assistance, seminars and presentations. You will work in the field of robot autonomy, and all activities will be linked to national, European and global research and development projects. The PhD position will involve intensive research activities in field experimentation and theoretical development. Research areas:
 
 
Long-term autonomy in uncertain environments
 
a. Agentic planning and reasoning
 
- Semantic mission planning using foundation models
 
- Task decomposition based on foundation models
 
- Event-driven task replanning
 
 
b. Autonomous inspection planning
 
- Uncertainty aware planning
 
- Multi-agent systems for inspection planning
 
 
Qualifications
 
To qualify for the position, you must hold a master’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science or another relevant subject. Good knowledge of C++, Python and ROS 2 is required. Good scientific skills, with demonstrated proficiency in experimental research, and very good communication skills are an advantage. You will represent the group in various contexts, both in Sweden and abroad, so very good knowledge of English is required.
 
 
For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en.
 
 
Further information
 
Employment as a PhD student is limited to four years. Teaching and other departmental duties may be added, up to 20% of full-time working hours. The place of work is Luleå, and the starting date is by agreement.
 
 
For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.
 
 
For further information, please contact:
 
George Nikolakopoulos, Chaired Professor, +46 920-49 1298 mailto:geonik@ltu.se
 
 
https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Tradeunioncontactsrepresentatives
 
 
In case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions o this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence.
 
 
Application
 
We prefer that you apply for this position by clicking on the apply button below. The application should include a CV, personal letter and copies of verified diplomas from high school and universities. Mark your application with the reference number below. Your application, including diplomas, must be written in English or Swedish.
 
 
Closing date for applications: 7 December 2026
 
Reference number: 5833-2026

⚡️ What We Do
Flower is Flexible Power. We are a next-gen energy company leveraging AI and machine learning to make renewable energy stable and always available – even when the sun isn't shining and the wind isn't blowing.
Through smart optimization and trading of energy assets like wind and solar farms, battery systems, and EV chargers, we make renewable energy reliable and predictable, leading the charge towards the energy system of tomorrow.

🌟 Who We Are
Tech company at heart – purpose in our DNA. Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world.
At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.
To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for a passionate and skilled Asset Developer Germany to join our BESS Development team.

About the role
As an Asset Developer at Flower, you will lead the development of large-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) and other flexible assets from lead origination all the way to Ready-to-Build. You will be responsible for securing land rights, grid connections, and permits, while collaborating closely with our EPC team and internal technical experts across the Nordics and Europe.
This role sits within our BESS Development domain and reports to the Head of BESS development. You will be at the forefront of Flower's expansion into Germany, navigating the local regulatory landscape and building strong stakeholder relationships to drive project success.

What you'll do
• Lead the development of projects in all stages, from Lead generation to Ready to Build, ensuring project success through efficient timeline, budget, and resource management.
• Conduct technical assessments, secure grid connections, and oversee permitting processes in collaboration with Flower's internal technical teams and external stakeholders.
• Negotiate with landowners, grid operators, and other stakeholders to optimize project timelines and resources.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with external stakeholders, including landowners, industries, grid operators, authorities, municipalities, and local communities.
• Manage the preparation and submission of necessary permits and approvals, ensuring all projects comply with local, regional, and national regulations.
• Ensure that your projects are financially solid and that they align with company requirements.
• Identify and address potential risks through proactive planning and problem-solving, ensuring the smooth progression of projects.
• Represent the company at industry events, public meetings, and regulatory hearings, strengthening Flower's presence in the renewable energy sector.
• Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure seamless integration of technical expertise and strategic alignment.

Who you are
• Bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in project development within the renewable energy sector.
• Proven track record of successfully developing and delivering large-scale projects.
• Strong technical background and expertise in the energy sector.
• In-depth knowledge of the German energy market and regulatory environment.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; experience with municipalities and the public sector is highly valued.
• Experience with grid connection processes is highly valued.
• Native German speaker with proficiency in English.

📍 Location
Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm, just a short walk from Slussen subway station. We encourage in-office collaboration but support a hybrid work model.

jobs.occupation: Maintenance Foreman till SMS group Nordic.
jobs.description:
SMS group är ledande inom framtidsinriktade teknologier och god service för metallindustrin. År 2024 genererade vårt team på över 13 500 anställda världen över en omsättning på över 4 miljarder euro. Vi använder våra 150 års erfarenhet och vår digitala expertis för att kontinuerligt tillhandahålla branschen med innovativa produkter och processer som sträcker sig bortom vår kärnverksamhet. Vi är den rätta partnern för utmanande projekt och stödjer våra kunder genom hela livscykeln för deras anläggningar och utrustning. Att bana vägen för en koldioxidneutral och hållbar metallindustri är vårt uttalade mål.
Om rollen / About the role
Svenska
Är du en erfaren underhållsledare med gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av tung industriell utrustning? SMS group söker en arbetsledare för mekaniskt underhåll som ska leda verkstadsarbetet och bidra till att kritisk utrustning i stålverket är driftsäker, säker och redo för produktion.
I rollen leder du ett team som ansvarar för reparation, renovering och översyn av utrustning såsom valslipmaskiner, fräsmaskiner, valslagerhus, lagerenheter samt annan verkstads- och stålverksutrustning. Du kombinerar ett närvarande och praktiskt ledarskap på verkstadsgolvet med planering, felsökning och kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete.
Du samordnar underhållsverkstadens dagliga arbete och ser till att prioriteringar, resurser och tekniska krav är tydliga. Du stöttar teamet i att lösa utrustningsproblem och bidrar till förbättringar som stärker säkerheten, kvaliteten och driftsäkerheten.
Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:
Planera och prioritera verkstadsarbetet utifrån produktionens behov
Ansvara för reparationer, inspektioner, precisionspassning och renovering av utrustning
Felsöka mekaniska, hydrauliska och pneumatiska problem
Utveckla förebyggande underhåll för verkstads- och stålverksutrustning
Stödja grundorsaksanalyser och följa upp korrigerande åtgärder
Följa upp underhållsresultat, bland annat efterlevnad av förebyggande underhåll, MTBF, MTTR och andelen effektivt underhållsarbete
Säkerställa korrekt underhållsdokumentation och effektiv användning av personal, utrustning och reservdelar

Du förväntas föregå med gott exempel och säkerställa att säkerhetsrutiner, inklusive Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), följs. Du har också mandat att stoppa arbetet om säkerhet, kvalitet eller regelefterlevnad riskeras.
English
Are you an experienced maintenance leader with a strong hands-on background in heavy industrial equipment? SMS group is looking for a Mechanical Maintenance Foreman to lead workshop activities and help keep critical steel mill machinery reliable, safe and ready for operation.
In this role, you will lead a team responsible for repairing, rebuilding and overhauling equipment such as roll grinding machines, milling machines, roll chocks, bearing assemblies and other workshop and mill equipment. You will combine practical shop-floor leadership with planning, troubleshooting and continuous improvement.
You will coordinate the daily work of the maintenance workshop, making sure priorities, resources and technical requirements are clear. You will support the team in resolving equipment issues and contribute to improvements that strengthen safety, quality and reliability.
Your responsibilities will include:
Planning and prioritising workshop work in line with production needs
Overseeing repairs, inspections, precision fitting and equipment rebuilds
Troubleshooting mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic issues
Developing preventive maintenance practices for workshop and mill equipment
Supporting root cause analysis and following up on corrective actions
Monitoring maintenance performance, including preventive maintenance compliance, MTBF, MTTR and wrench time
Ensuring accurate maintenance documentation and effective use of people, equipment and spare parts

You are expected to lead by example and ensure that safety procedures, including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), are followed. You also have the authority to stop work if safety, quality or compliance may be at risk.
Din profil / Your profile
Svenska
Du har en gedigen bakgrund inom industriellt underhåll och trivs med att kombinera teknisk problemlösning med att stötta ett team. Du är strukturerad, lätt att samarbeta med och trygg i att fatta beslut om arbetsprioriteringar.
Vi söker dig som har:
Erfarenhet av att samordna eller leda yrkesarbetare i en verkstad eller på verkstadsgolvet
Goda kunskaper inom mekaniska system och erfarenhet av hydraulisk och pneumatisk utrustning
Praktisk erfarenhet av utrustning såsom valslagerhus, lagerenheter, valslipmaskiner, fräsmaskiner eller svarvar
Ett strukturerat arbetssätt för underhållsplanering och problemlösning
God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samarbeta med olika funktioner 
En relevant teknisk högskoleutbildning, yrkesutbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet

English
You have a solid background in industrial maintenance and enjoy combining technical problem-solving with supporting a team. You are organised, approachable and comfortable making decisions about work priorities.
We are looking for someone with:
Experience coordinating or leading skilled tradespeople in a workshop or on the shop floor
Strong knowledge of mechanical systems, with experience in hydraulic and pneumatic equipment
Practical experience with equipment such as roll chocks, bearing assemblies, roll grinding machines, milling machines or lathes
A structured approach to maintenance planning and problem-solving
Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across functions
A relevant technical degree, vocational qualification or equivalent experience

Är detta för dig? / Is this for you?
Svenska
Låter detta som en intressant möjlighet? Välkommen till en arbetsplats där din utveckling är central och där vi tillsammans skapar morgondagens lösningar. Vi ser fram emot att ta emot din ansökan! Då rekryterings teamet är internationellt önskar vi ditt CV och personliga brev på engelska.
Urval kommer att pågå under ansökningstiden varpå tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.
English
Does this sound like an interesting opportunity? Welcome to a workplace where your development is central and where we together create tomorrow’s solutions. We look forward to receiving your CV and personal letter in English!
The selection process will be ongoing during the application period, which may lead to that the position may be filled before the last day of application.

Kravprofil
We are searching for a Freeze-drying specialist for an assignment at our customer site in Stockholm.
The Freeze-Drying Specialist will support recipe development, process scale-up, troubleshooting of products and processes, and procurement of new equipment.
REQUIREMENTS
- PhD, Pharmacist degree, Medical Technology Engineering degree, or equivalent.
- Minimum 6 years of relevant professional experience.
- Experience from working in regulated environment, eg GMP.
- Experience from validation activities.
- Experience in freeze-drying recipe development and process scale-up.
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
- Fluent communication skills in English and Swedish.
- Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
- Ability to work in office, laboratory, and production environments

Software Engineer
System-level development, background services, and platform logic.
This role suits you if you enjoy understanding what happens under the hood and building stable components that run reliably on hundreds of millions of devices.
Must have
• iOS development experience
• Computer science fundamentals
• Understanding of threads, concurrency, and asynchronous programming
• Ability to write robust, fault-tolerant, and efficient code for long-running processes.
• Strong communication skills and fluent English.
Nice to have
• Knowledge of security, privacy, encryption, or communication protocols.
• Experience with complex or distributed systems.
• Familiarity with Bluetooth or other low-level communication layers.
• Deep understanding of modern Swift concurrency

jobs.description:
Har du ett intresse för hantverk, kreativitet och lärande? Vill du inspirera elever att utveckla sin skaparglädje och praktiska förmåga? Då kan du vara den vi söker!

IES Årsta söker nu en engagerad lärare i träslöjd för en deltidsanställning på 20 %, förlagd till torsdagar kl. 08.00–15.30.

Om IES Årsta

Internationella Engelska Skolan Årsta är en grundskola för årskurs 4–9 med cirka 440 elever och 60 medarbetare. Vi är stolta över vår internationella gemenskap där höga akademiska förväntningar, trygghet och respekt står i centrum.

Skolan ligger i Årsta med goda kommunikationer till både Gullmarsplan och Årstaberg.

Läs mer om oss på www.engelska.se.

Om tjänsten

Som lärare i träslöjd ansvarar du för att planera och genomföra undervisning där eleverna får utveckla sin kreativitet, sitt hantverkskunnande och sin problemlösningsförmåga. Du skapar en trygg och strukturerad lärmiljö där eleverna får möjlighet att arbeta praktiskt och utvecklas utifrån sina egna förutsättningar.

Vi söker dig som

- Har goda kunskaper inom träslöjd och olika hantverkstekniker.
- Är trygg i ditt ledarskap och kan skapa struktur och säkerhet i slöjdsalen.
- Har förmåga att inspirera och vägleda elever.
- Är ansvarstagande, kreativ och lösningsorienterad.
- Trivs med att samarbeta med kollegor.

Lärarlegitimation med behörighet i slöjd är meriterande, liksom tidigare erfarenhet av pedagogiskt arbete. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. 

Vill du bli en del av vårt team?

Skicka in din ansökan via IES Careers. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post.

För att arbeta inom skolan krävs ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret som inte är äldre än sex månader.

Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta recruitment.arsta@engelska.se.

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.
